eval: (() => { if (!document.title.includes('Surfers Paradise') || window.__game.state !== 'title' || window.__game.world.track.id !== 'gold-coast') throw new Error('Gold Coast title did not load'); return {title:document.title,circuit:window.__game.world.track.id,lengthM:window.__game.world.track.length}; })()

(() => { const g = window.__game; if (g.state !== 'race' || g.race.player.vehicle.speed < 1) throw new Error('Race did not drive'); return { state: g.state, speed: g.race.player.vehicle.speed, quality: g.settings.quality }; })()
